text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, Shinko Windy hasn't been feeling 
her best. Thinking a change of pace might 
help, we came to the shrine."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? The one over there is... Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, Windy-senpai! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't expect to run into you in a place 
like this, Biko! Did you come to visit the 
shrine?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was just thinking of drawing a 
fortune or something.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm going to be performing in a 
hero show at an upcoming shopping district 
event.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna know if the show's gonna go 
well. Thought I'd check our fortune!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I bet you're gonna end up drawing 
bad luck anyway, you hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is the worst right before an 
important show nanoda! I might get scared 
and mess up nanoda~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, if you're trying to intimidate me, 
it's not gonna work!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely gonna make this show a 
huge success! Uoooooooooh!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's Great Fortune!! With this, 
our show is guaranteed to be a huge 
success!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Windy-senpai! Justice always 
prevails!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nunununu... In the end, evil shall 
prevail!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rawr! Prepare yourself, Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! You villain, Windy!! My sense of 
justice won't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the battle between hero and 
villain began. Staring each other down 
with utter seriousness, a heated battle 
unfolded before our eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... You're pretty good, nanoda... 
I'll call it a draw for today, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phantom Windy! If you go on a rampage 
again, I'll definitely stop you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just try it if you think you can! I'm 
gonna power up even more before next time, 
nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"The next time we meet shall be your end!! 
Bwa-ha-ha-ha-ha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...! Great Curse...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! Just as Windy-chan 
predicted!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Your hero show is definitely going to be a 
failure...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh. Everyone was looking forward to 
it, too..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey...! It's only a fortune slip. Pay it 
no mind!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't be so down, you're supposed to be 
a hero! Even though you're Windy-chan's 
rival...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't make that kind of face~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy grew crestfallen and 
downcast. Her condition didn't improve 
after that...
